text:
Eve S: Hey folks — I pushed fixes for PR #5423 (addressed the flake we saw in CI). Short summary: reduced flaky test timeout, swapped sleep() for wait_for_condition, and added a lightweight smoke e2e that only runs on canary. PTAL when you have a minute.

Ravi K: Thanks, I can take a quick look now and run the smoke locally.

ci-bot: CI started for branch fix/flake-5423 — 3 checks queued.

Maya L: Quick question — did we preserve the previous default for READ_TIMEOUT? I couldn't find it in the diff.

Eve S: Good catch. I added a fallback in runtime_config so behavior is unchanged if the env var isn't set. Snippet I left in the PR comment:
```
const timeout = process.env.READ_TIMEOUT || 1500
```
Link to comment is in the PR.

Jamal T: Ran the smoke locally, passed for me. Small nit: test name `retry_flow` is a bit vague — can you rename to `retry_flow_on_backoff` so it's clearer in flakiness dashboards?

Eve S: Done — renamed and added a one-line comment explaining the intent. PTAL @Ravi @Maya.

Ravi K: LGTM from me. :+1: I'll approve on GitHub once CI is green.

ci-bot: All checks passed — 4/4.

Maya L: Approved. Thanks for the fast turnaround.

Eve S: Thanks everyone. I'll merge during the 14:00 UTC canary slot and monitor. I'll also drop a short rollback note in the PR in case we need to revert.

Ravi K: Got it — ping me if you want me to shadow the canary.

Eve S: Will do, thanks :rocket:
